title: Upper respiratory and peripheral blood gene expression profiles of children, adolescents, and adults with SARS-CoV-2 infection
description: The goal of this analysis is to evaluate the extent to which transcriptomic profiles associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection differ by age. Overall design: Gene expression profiling of upper respiratory and peripheral blood samples was performed using nasopharyngeal and peripheral blood samples from individuals with SARS-CoV-2 infection and uninfected controls
